title: CulturePark: Boosting Cross-cultural Understanding in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly categorizes and evaluates 'human beliefs' as a core component of its cross-cultural framework. In the dialogue dataset analysis (Section B.2 and Figure 8), the authors reveal that 'human belief' makes up nearly 60% of their data, which is further subdivided into 'religious beliefs' (31.31%) and 'ethical beliefs' (13.92%). Additionally, the paper benchmarks models on content moderation tasks including hate speech and bias detection.
